image_prompt.text: An open gathering area inside the park sized for a crowd waiting, resting and watching
A distinct structure visible across the park floor so visitors can orient themselves
The entrance, placed so the first thing a visitor sees is the length of the park
A big trampoline park - a large hall floored with trampoline beds separated by padded walkways

layout_placement.text: Arrival point at the park entrance

notes: Stage A landed on None: a trampoline park is a place, not a game type. No genre was invented for it.
Enclosure was set to interior-only because trampoline parks are conventionally indoor halls; the prompt does not actually say so, and it costs nothing either way.
The trampoline surfaces themselves matched no option and are carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: Is this just a place to bounce around in, or is there a game on top of it - dodgeball, tag, a trick scoring system?
Bright commercial trampoline park, or something more stylized?
Indoor hall or an outdoor park? And what attractions besides the main floor - foam pit, dodgeball court, basketball?

coverage_missing.ask: Is there a game here, or is it a hangout?
Which attractions do you want besides the main trampoline floor?
How big is big - a single hall, or a whole complex?

answers.ask: Is this just a place to bounce around in, or is there a game on top of it - dodgeball, tag, a trick scoring system?
answers.answer: Just a place to bounce around in, with no additional game mode or scoring system.

answers.ask: Bright commercial trampoline park, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Use a bright commercial trampoline park look.

answers.ask: Indoor hall or an outdoor park? And what attractions besides the main floor - foam pit, dodgeball court, basketball?
answers.answer: Make it an indoor hall with a large main trampoline floor and a foam pit; do not add extra game attractions.
